snippet.title: Worshippers of Cthulhu - Official 1.0 Release Date Trailer | Lovecraftian Horror Strategy Game
snippet.description:
Mark your calendars. The madness begins May 22.

Worshippers of Cthulhu is a dark, strategy-driven city builder steeped in Lovecraftian horror. Manage cults, resources, and the crumbling minds of your people as you try to resist—or embrace—the will of the Old Ones.

👁️ Coming May 22 to Steam:
- City-building gameplay with deep strategic layers  
- Rituals, sanity systems, and cult-driven progression  
- A dark narrative inspired by H.P. Lovecraft  
- Atmospheric visuals and haunting soundtrack  

🌒 Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2807150/Worshippers_of_Cthulhu/
🗣️ Join the Cult (Discord/Website): https://discord.gg/xxVw8MDQ6Z

Like, comment, and subscribe if you feel the pull of the void.

#WorshippersOfCthulhu #LovecraftianStrategy #CityBuilder #HorrorGame #ComingSoon #SteamGame  #ReleaseDateTrailer
